oracle-l5r-10525.note: Koan's Robes (Item, issue #737): "This Personality has a Force bonus equal to the number of other Koan cards in this unit. This Personality need not bow for his Spells with an even Focus Value (0 is even). Negate the first destruction each turn of cards in this unit from another player's card." Part is merged: "need not bow for his Spells with an even Focus Value" is P24's EngineHooks.CostWaivers with SpellFocusParityWaives (odd: false; EffectPrimitivesCosts.cs, written for this card and Koan's Jingasa), and the destruction negation is a P7 standing watch whose scope is the gap (a StandingWatch covers the card, its controller's cards that fit a keyword, or its attached Followers; there is no cards-in-this-unit scope, and a Condition could stand in for it). Still missing: the Force bonus equal to the number of other Koan cards in this unit. Batch 3 merged its stat terms (StatTerms.cs), but the counters are only AttachedWithKeyword (the host's own attachments) and OpposingTokens; none counts a keyword across a unit (host, Followers and the other attachments). Publishing it without that sentence would drop printed text.

oracle-l5r-10378.note: Imperial Deployment (Strategy, issue #737): "Open: Choose your performing Personality: The Empress dispatches him to the Colonies. Negate other players' cards' effects that prevent him assigning. After the next time this turn an attack is declared, straighten his unit." Two gaps, the first narrower than first noted. (1) P12's Prevention immunity reads movement locks, which also refuse assigning (MovementLocked and MovementKinds.Assign, MovementLocks.cs; docs/decisions/2026-10-06-p12-immunities.md), so a lock made by another player's card with a known source player is covered. Locks with no source player (Too Close to Home, The Perfect Moment) and P11's stored NoAttack/NoDefend restrictions (no source player) are not, so whether that is enough is a reading. (2) "After the next time this turn an attack is declared, straighten his unit": P6's nearest fact is AssignedToAttack, per Personality (AfterFacts.cs), not the declaration of an attack, and there is no one-shot next-time-this-turn watch on a fact; the reading (declaration or first assignment) needs Mendon. "Dispatches him to the Colonies" is flavor text with no rule.
